description.value: Half Blind Bean Coffee is a specialty espresso bar in Kelowna's Richter Street neighbourhood, built around locally roasted beans and a consistent approach to craft coffee. The café welcomes both quick stops and longer visits, pairing espresso drinks with fresh baking made without shortcuts. It holds a 4.8-star customer rating and also sells retail beans for home or on-the-road brewing.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and confirms a specialty espresso café at 3320 Richter St #106, Kelowna operating Monday–Friday; the address was absent from OSM and has been sourced from the website footer. The website corroborates the OSM email (info@hbbcoffee.ca) and URL. No cyclist-specific amenities — bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi — are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all remain null.
concerns: OSM record has no street address; address sourced from website footer: 3320 Richter St #106, Kelowna, BC V1W (postal code appears truncated on website — only three characters shown).
No phone number in OSM or on website.
Closed Saturday and Sunday per both OSM opening_hours tag and website hours — limited weekend access for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating specialty coffee shop in Kelowna with a live website, confirmed address, and recent customer reviews — a legitimate stop for touring cyclists.
